title: Experience Delta

summary: Surface & Experience schema mirrored from Algorithm with source and destination hash lineage preserved.

lines: Experience Delta is part of Surface & Experience.
proseSections.excerpt: Surface & Experience schema with preserved source-hash lineage and validator compatibility.

schemaFields.label: actionability_state
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Disambiguates whether the shell is presenting one safe next move or explicit NO_SAFE_ACTION semantics. This prevents terminal reload and reconnect from inferring actionability from null checks.

schemaFields.label: active_detail_surface_code
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Currently expanded low-noise detail module, persisted so reconnect and terminal reload can restore drawer context without route changes.

schemaFields.label: detail_entry_points
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Ordered low-noise detail modules relevant to the current posture. These are investigation entry points, not alternate command-side truth.

schemaFields.label: experience_profile
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: User-facing shell profile carried on every delta so clients can bind one deterministic renderer. The current contract exposes only the low-noise composite shell.

schemaFields.label: focus_anchor_ref
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Stable focused object ref inside the active detail module. Clients SHALL preserve it when the object still exists after a live update.

schemaFields.label: no_safe_action_reason_code
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Machine-stable reason explaining why no safe legal action is currently available.

schemaFields.label: primary_action_code
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Machine-stable dominant safe next action when `actionability_state = ACTION_AVAILABLE`. Null is legal only when the shell is explicitly in `NO_SAFE_ACTION` posture.

schemaFields.label: suggested_detail_surface_code
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Least-destructive detail module that should open when the shell needs to route the user from `NO_SAFE_ACTION` or a blocking posture into investigation.

schemaFields.label: experienceFrame
schemaFields.descriptionOrNull: Optional companion structure for reconnect-safe frame restoration. The same surface object shape is reused by LOAD_OR_BUILD_LATEST_EXPERIENCE_FRAME(...).
